# corpus-clean-new-file - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the ULW plan author who needs a machine-readable review corpus.
**Outcome:** a clean plan that cites a to-be-created module and must not be rejected.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；1 个实施 todo + F1；新目标不是缺失引用。

## Verification strategy

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

- [ ] 1. 新建语料库真值校验器
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 新建 `lib/review-corpus-new.js` 与 `test/review-corpus-new.test.mjs`；阅读 `docs/fidelity.md`；不修改 `lib/review-lint.js`。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: F1
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`lib/review-corpus-new.js`；`test/**/*.test.mjs`；https://example.com/corpus/spec；`$E/task-1.txt`；IS-1。
  Acceptance criteria: `node --test test/review-corpus-new.test.mjs` 退出 0，且新模块没有副作用。
  QA scenarios: Happy “new-file-is-not-missing-reference” 待新建模块只产生 warning。Failure “missing-marker” 删除校验标记后断言失败。
  Commit: Y | test(corpus): clean new file case

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

- [ ] F1. Plan compliance audit
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit
  What to do / Must NOT do: 只读核对每个 todo 与证据；不修改任何文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 2 | Blocked by: 1 | Blocks: —
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 每项都有证据。
  QA scenarios: Happy “audit-passes” 逐项对照证据。Failure “no-evidence” 缺证据即拒绝。
  Commit: N | 审计不单独提交

## Commit strategy
- 每个 N 项与测试一起提交。
